channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-71362 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

item.title: CVE-2026-5430 — WSO2 Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 69. WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-65660 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-67279 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.
